scope: Additive correction of the Home Village X-Bow footprint. The earlier frozen sources and conclusions remain intact.
game_version: The pinned payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Its X-Bow size field says 4x4, which is contradicted by two independent published Home Village references. Neither geometry reference identifies a current client build.

sources.title: X-Bow - Clash of Clans Guide
sources.limitations: The page states a 3x3 footprint, ranges and cadence, but has no stated publication date or client version.

sources.title: X-Bow - Clash of Clans Complete Guide to Defenses
sources.limitations: Historical secondary confirmation of the 3x3 size only. It cannot establish current damage or upgrade values.

footprint_tiles.note: The raw 4x4 field conflicts with two independent Home Village references. This correction changes Core collision, pathfinding, deployment margin, selection and rendering from the shared footprint, without a Viewer-side compensating scale.

changed_values.previous_state: The pinned upstream payload and normalized catalogue used a 4x4 footprint.
changed_values.replacement: All X-Bow levels use a 3x3 footprint.
changed_values.justification: Two independent Home Village references explicitly report 3x3. The upstream field is retained in its immutable raw cache and superseded only through this dated additive correction.

known_uncertainties: No consulted first-party Supercell page publishes the X-Bow footprint or a versioned geometry contract.
The correction has secondary corroboration but no source-identifiable current client build. It must be rechecked if Supercell changes X-Bow geometry.
conclusion: The X-Bow now exposes the verified 3x3 Home Village footprint through the shared Core geometry. Its existing ammunition and projectile-timing uncertainties remain unchanged.
